capabilities._note: Text to image only: no reference images. MOSS-Image (the base model the SFT is fine-tuned from: for LoRAs trained on the base, and for comparing; not picked as a default by itself (no default_rank)). Its layout prompts (boxes drawn in ComfyUI's Create Bounding Boxes, MOSSImageLayoutPrompt) aren't used: seriesmith writes the whole picture as one caption.

template._note: Sizes a series ref is generated at (as krea2's). The model card's own examples are 1024x1024; dimensions must be multiples of 16. A keyframe is generated at its shot's render size, scaled up (same aspect, multiples of size_multiple) to at least min_pixels.

recipe._note: Series refs are worded as krea2 words them (targets/image/common.py). Keyframes: targets/image/common.py keyframe_prompt.

binding._note: An API graph after ComfyUI's MOSS-Image support (comfy/supported_models.py MOSSImage, 0.41): UNETLoader, CLIPLoader type moss_image (Qwen3.5 9B), FLUX.2's VAE and empty latent (MOSS-Image is a flow model on the FLUX.2 latent), ModelSamplingAuraFlow at the model's own shift 5, a positive and an empty negative CLIPTextEncode, KSampler euler/simple. The model card's negative-branch layer skipping (layer 22) is left out: an ordinary cfg pass instead. H3SaveRefTake takes the place of SaveImage; prune drops anything it doesn't need.

models._note: Name-based identification only: no header fingerprint is recorded for MOSS-Image yet (targets/modelid.py). Base and SFT share their architecture and are told apart by name (moss-image-base); the sft is excluded so it never stands in. The bf16 copy of the same model resolves by family. The text encoder is Qwen3.5 9B (int8 here; its bf16 and w4a8 copies count too); the VAE is FLUX.2's.

presets._note: The model card's defaults: 50 steps, cfg 3, flow-matching Euler (euler/simple), shift 5, an empty negative prompt.

downloads._note: Comfy-Org's repackaging (Apache 2.0, not gated). The repo also has bf16 copies of each model (twice the size) and bf16 / w4a8 copies of the text encoder; the int8 ones are the default here, and the others resolve by family.
